rationale: P identifies the operational conditions and braking behaviour needed to evaluate prevention of omitted required braking. Braking initiation belongs to the target itself, while H-1 establishes stopping in time to avoid collision as part of the relevant phenomenon. P does not expand into the mechanisms used to sense, compute, communicate, or control that behaviour.
determining_elements: “Braking-relevant operational state in obstacle/collision-avoidance situations” identifies the conditions in which braking is required, supported by H-1 and FR-7.
“Whether a required braking maneuver is initiated” directly addresses the omission prohibited by SG-1; FR-7 and FR-7.1 further support including braking initiation.

“Whether the vehicle can stop in time to avoid collision” reflects H-1's hazardous event. This timing concerns the vehicle's collision-avoiding behaviour, not merely an observation or computation deadline.
The declared straight-ahead road-context scope is grounded in H-1, whose hazardous event includes both road users and static obstacles.
